profileView.description: A Colibri user as the AppView serves them: identity, resolved profile, and presence.

handle.description: The user's handle, or 'handle.invalid' when it does not resolve.

displayName.description: Resolved display name, falling back to the handle.

pronouns.description: Resolved pronouns, taken from the profile record, or from Bluesky when the user syncs with Bluesky and set none here.

avatar.description: URL of the user's avatar, served by this AppView's blob proxy.

banner.description: URL of the user's profile banner, served by this AppView's blob proxy.

isBot.description: Whether the account is labelled as an automated account.

syncBluesky.description: Whether the mirrored profile fields come from app.bsky.actor.profile.

theme.description: Colibri-only profile theming, read from the profile record even when the mirrored fields come from Bluesky.

preferredBadge.description: Label value of the badge the user chose to display.

presence.description: Live presence, when the AppView is tracking any.

bridge.description: Present when this is someone on another service whose messages a bridge relays. They have no Colibri account of their own.

voice.description: Where the user is connected for voice, if anywhere.

activities.description: What the user is doing right now, one entry per service they share from. Empty when the AppView has nothing current for them.

status.description: A user's status line. It carries text, an emoji, or both.

text.description: The status text. Absent for an emoji-only status.

emoji.description: A Unicode emoji shown beside the status.

customEmoji.description: A custom emoji shown beside the status. Takes the place of emoji when both are present.

expiresAt.description: When the status clears. The AppView stops returning the status once this time passes. Absent means it never expires.

showWhileOffline.description: Whether a client shows the status while the user is offline.

activity.description: Something the user is doing right now, read from another service they publish to. A client renders it beside their presence.

kind.description: What sort of activity this is. A client that does not know a kind falls back to naming the source.

title.description: The main line: a track, a game, or a stream title.

subtitle.description: The second line, such as the artist.

detail.description: A third line naming where the title sits, such as the album.

imageUri.description: Artwork for the activity, served by this AppView. Absent when none could be resolved.

linkUri.description: Where the activity points, such as the track's page on the service it was played from.

endsAt.description: After this the activity is no longer current. The AppView clears it and says so, and a client treats a lapsed activity as absent.

source.description: The service the activity was read from, such as 'teal.fm'.

channel.description: The voice channel the user is connected to.

muted.description: Whether the user's microphone is muted, for any reason.

deafened.description: Whether the user has incoming audio silenced, for any reason.

serverMuted.description: Whether a moderator muted them. When this is true they cannot unmute themselves, and a client must not offer them the control.

serverDeafened.description: Whether a moderator deafened them. When this is true they cannot undeafen themselves.

camera.description: Whether the user is sharing their camera.

screen.description: Whether the user is sharing their screen.

preferences.description: The authenticated user's own settings, as the AppView currently holds them.

gifFavorites.description: GIFs saved from the picker, stored whole.

shareActivity.description: Whether the AppView may read what the user is listening to and show it to others.

spaceNotifications.description: Notification levels the user set for single communities. A community without an entry follows notificationLevel.

spaceModerations.description: Moderation view options the user set for single communities. A community without an entry follows clientPreferences.

clientPreferences.description: Client settings that follow the user across devices.

composerState.description: Emoji usage, skin tone and recent GIFs.

subject.description: What is muted. A user or a community is named by DID, a channel or a thread by its space.

mutedChannel.description: A muted channel. Muting a channel silences it without leaving the community it belongs to.

mutedThread.description: A muted thread. Muting a thread silences it without leaving the channel it sits beside.

spaceNotification.description: A notification level for one community.

level.description: Which messages in this community produce a notification.

spaceModeration.description: Moderation view options for one community.

hideModeratedMessages.description: Whether messages a moderator hid stay out of view in this community.

clientPreferences.description: Client settings that follow the user across devices. Every field is optional and a client applies its own default for an absent one.

theme.description: The color theme. system follows the operating system.

messagePreviews.description: Whether the channel list shows the latest message under each channel name.

linkEmbedsByDefault.description: Whether a link in a new message gets a preview by default.

gifLoopLimit.description: How many times a GIF in chat plays before it pauses. Absent means no limit.

warnOnExternalLinks.description: Whether opening a link to another site asks for confirmation first.

blueskyClient.description: The client that Bluesky posts and profiles open in.

customBlueskyClientBase.description: The domain of the client used when blueskyClient is custom.

inboxPresentation.description: How the inbox opens on desktop. popover anchors it to the inbox button, modal opens it in a large dialog.

developerMode.description: Whether the client shows identifiers and links to inspect records.

hideModeratedMessages.description: Whether messages a moderator hid stay out of view for a user who could otherwise see them. A community can override this with an entry in spaceModerations.

experiments.description: The experiments the user turned on.

swipeLeftAction.description: What swiping left on a message does.

doubleTapEnabled.description: Whether double tapping a message does anything.

doubleTapAction.description: What double tapping a message does.

doubleTapReactionEmoji.description: The emoji a double tap reacts with.

confirmJoin.description: Whether opening a voice channel waits for the user to press join.

showNonVideoParticipants.description: Whether the call grid shows participants without video.

showOwnCamera.description: Whether the call grid shows the user's own camera.

composerState.description: Emoji usage, skin tone and recent GIFs.

emojiUsage.description: The emoji the user picks most, with counts.

skinTone.description: The skin tone for emoji that support one. 0 is the default yellow.

recentGifs.description: The GIFs the user sent last, newest first, stored whole.

emojiUse.description: How often and how recently the user picked one emoji.

emoji.description: A Unicode emoji, or a custom emoji's AT URI.

count.description: How many times the user picked it.

lastUsed.description: When the user last picked it.
